name: com.youcited/cited
title: Cited
description: Measure and improve how often AI assistants cite your business: GEO audits, fixes, and docs.

environmentVariables.name: CITED_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cited login token (run `cited login`, then `cited auth token`). Optional: without it, use the login tool or the no-login free_audit and search_docs tools.

environmentVariables.name: CITED_AGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cited Agent API key for the structured Agent API tools (facts, claims, comparisons). Optional.
